sections.title: Snow ratio.
sections.note: Given the measured water, how far off is the snowfall? 1,197 hand-measured Sierra snow days, 2021 to 2026; each winter is scored by a model that never saw it.

sections.title: Rain or snow.
sections.note: Water wrongly called rain or snow per wet day, at 22 Tahoe snow sensors over 3,594 held-out days. The three methods are close; calling everything snow would miss by 4.9 mm.

sections.title: Water.
sections.note: Model water against what 22 SNOTEL stations measured, on the 2025 and 2026 winters held out in turn. Correction fixes the totals and big storms; ordinary single days get slightly worse, because scaling a forecast up also scales up its misses.

sections.title: Live forecasts.
sections.note: Every forecast this page shows is archived and will be graded against the stations by lead day as it comes due, including the ranges. That table starts filling in after the first week.
